item.title: Lake Inawashiro: Japan's Swan Lake Beneath Mount Bandai — Guide
item.description: Lake Inawashiro, Japan’s fourth-largest lake, sits in the shadow of Mount Bandai’s dramatic slopes, its clear waters earning it the nickname ‘Heaven’s Mirror’ for its reflections of the mountain. Each winter, thousands of migratory whooper swans arrive from Siberia to overwinter along the shoreline, particularly around Nagahama beach, creating one of the region’s most beloved wildlife spectacles. In summer, the lake’s beaches and water sports draw visitors, while the surrounding shoreline offers cycling routes with mountain views.
